definitions.explanation: A person or people of the opposite sex. Used when discussing attraction, relationships, and social interactions between men and women.

examples.japanese: {異性|いせい}の{友人|ゆうじん}はいますか。
examples.english: Do you have friends of the opposite sex?

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{異性|いせい}にとても{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: He is very popular with the opposite sex.

examples.japanese: {異性|いせい}との{付|つ}き{合|あ}いに{慣|な}れていないので、{緊張|きんちょう}してうまく{話|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: I wasn't used to interacting with the opposite sex, so I was nervous and couldn't speak well.

notes:
USAGE:
{異性|いせい} is a neutral, standard term for the opposite sex. It is commonly used in discussions about relationships, attraction, and social dynamics. The antonym is {同性|どうせい} (same sex).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異性|いせい}に{好|す}かれる (be liked by the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}の{友人|ゆうじん} (friend of the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}との{交際|こうさい} (dating someone of the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}を{意識|いしき}する (become aware of the opposite sex)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同性|どうせい}: the same sex (antonym)
- {男女|だんじょ}: men and women (refers to both sexes together)
- {異性愛|いせいあい}: heterosexuality (sexual orientation)
